corrected_consistency_analysis.limitation_note: The candidate_spectrum_comparison.tsv provides IC values computed over ALL passes combined. There is no per-pass candidate evaluation available in the data. This analysis checks whether the residual traces have sufficient temporal resolution to detect the rank-1 frequency (1010 muHz).

delta_ic_verification.delta_ic_definition: delta_IC = IC_candidate - IC_best (where IC is the information criterion)
